column1: [Comment to Article 6.1: Violations of Article 2.1 (Presence of a Prohibited Substance or its Metabolites or Markers) may be established only by Sample analysis performed by a WADA-approved laboratory or
column2: another laboratory specifically authorized by WADA. Violations of other Articles may be established using analytical results from other laboratories so long as the results are reliable.]

column1: [Comment to Article 6.2: For example, relevant profile information could be used to direct Target Testing or to support an anti-doping rule violation
column2: proceeding under Article 2.2 (Use or Attempted Use of a Prohibited Substance), or both.]
